audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: 3-year average operating income margin from FY2019-FY2021 is 14.3%
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated individual year margins correctly (2019: 18.4%, 2020: 4.5%, 2021: 20.1%), but the 3-year average should be (18.4 + 4.5 + 20.1) / 3 = 42.9 / 3 = 14.3%. Upon recalculation, this is actually correct. However, verifying: 1306/11503 = 11.35%, 509/11303 = 4.50%, 2112/10482 = 20.15%. Average = (11.35 + 4.50 + 20.15) / 3 = 12.0%, not 14.3%. The error is in the individual 2019 margin calculation (should be ~11.4%, not 18.4%), which propagated to the final average.
